snippet.title: Geometry Breakers - SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The SAGE 2025 Geometry Breakers is out now! Look for it on Sonic Fangames HQ's website!
Here, you will fight against the geometric enemies of the Dark Matter Empire in this high speed shoot em' up demo from Crab Team and Lagartimations.
Break it down, at SAGE 2025.

Lagartimations Channel:
https://www.youtube.com/@LagartimationsMedia

If there's any bugs or such, please send us feedback so we can fix it!

#sage2025 #breakitdown #geometrybreakers #crabteam #lagartimations #shootemup #indiegames
